title: HELIX Govern: Maturity Assessment Scorecard
description: A fillable self-assessment scorecard aligned to the HELIX 5-dimension maturity model. Score each dimension 1-5, provide evidence, and identify priority actions.

level_descriptions.1: No shared data definitions. Each system maintains its own terminology.
level_descriptions.2: HELIX Core reviewed as reference. Some definitions documented. Data dictionary started.
level_descriptions.3: Data lake silver layer maps to HELIX schemas. Data dictionary complete. Terminology code sets adopted.
level_descriptions.4: All major systems mapped to HELIX. Schema validation automated. Contributing extensions back to community.
level_descriptions.5: Full HELIX conformance. Schema evolution process in place. Serving as reference implementation.

level_descriptions.1: No formal governance roles. Data ownership is ad hoc.
level_descriptions.2: CDO appointed. Data Governance Council formed. Domain trustees identified.
level_descriptions.3: RACI matrix implemented. Stewards active in each domain. Regular council meetings.
level_descriptions.4: Governance integrated into project lifecycle. Data impact assessments required.
level_descriptions.5: Governance culture embedded institution-wide. Self-service governance tools.

level_descriptions.1: No formal quality measurement. Issues found reactively.
level_descriptions.2: Quality rules defined (HELIX rules adopted). Baseline measurements taken.
level_descriptions.3: Automated quality monitoring. Quality dashboard published. SLAs for critical data.
level_descriptions.4: Root cause analysis standard practice. Preventive controls in source systems.
level_descriptions.5: Predictive quality monitoring. Near-zero critical defects.

level_descriptions.1: No classification scheme. FERPA/GLBA compliance is ad hoc.
level_descriptions.3: Classification enforced in data lake. Access controls aligned. Audit logging active.
level_descriptions.4: Automated classification enforcement. PII tokenization. GLBA Safeguards program documented.
level_descriptions.5: Real-time access anomaly detection. Zero-trust for restricted data.

level_descriptions.1: Data governance seen as an IT concern. No shared vocabulary.
level_descriptions.2: Shared glossary (HELIX glossary) adopted. Training started.
level_descriptions.3: Governance awareness across departments. Self-service analytics with guardrails.
level_descriptions.4: Governance is a recognized priority. Embedded in onboarding. Champions in each dept.
level_descriptions.5: Data-informed culture. Leadership routinely uses governed data for decisions.

overall_score_calculation: Average of all 5 dimension scores. Round to one decimal.
